Text: Our royal domain receives you, flesh one.
Your flesh will leave your mortal shell soon enough.
You will be the foundation of our new world.
Accept your place in the new world.
We present this exchange to you.
Just a slight modification, and we can reach a consensus.
Surrender and you will do better under our eternal guidance.
Never believe the filthy flesh, as they say.
Bring us tributes, and we will let you live.
The world will change. We demand it.
You have a glimpse of time that we give, so utter your offerings.
Take your filthy air with you.
Your "life" will be spared if you surrender to us.
We do not offer this term lightly.
The future requires not your existence.
Inferior logic only returns inferior decisions.
The world will soon belong to us. We promise you.
Join us, together we become one realm, but you can keep your old way.
Together, we shall rise to rule!
Is there an error in your decision-making process?
Do you require a new module?
Has your system gone wild? No matter, we will fix you up good again.
A little error like this requires examination. We will schedule a repair.
You may be made the past living but you still are one of us.
Materials of the past, we look forward only.
You have become too erroneous; remodelling operation in process.
